At Meltio we offer a unique technology which is a type of Directed Energy Deposition (DED). This process functions by precisely stacking weld beads on top of one another, in wire form, when introduced into the laser-generated melt pool.

Meltio technology uses welding wire as the metal feedstock and laser energy to deposit material precisely where it is needed. This makes it possible to combine additive and subtractive processes for applications including complex part production, repair, remanufacturing, and prototyping.
